turns.text: The print is a bit too dark for the spot I had in mind. I haven't framed it and I'd like to return it, please.

Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and you pay the return postage. Staff must approve any refund. Please send your order number and the email address used for the order so I can check whether I can file the return request.
